annotations.text:
The entire logging surface is four verbs: Start Fishing · Log a Catch · These conditions suck · End Trip.
No trip ever needs all four. Tapping Log a Catch or These conditions suck with no open trip silently opens one behind the angler.

The most important screen in the app.
One tap sets zero_catch_confirmed_at AND catch_log_confidence = complete — the deliberate act that makes a trip countable in a rate.
Salt defers details to the leisure queue — tide is reconstructable later. Bass can't: water colour and structure live only in the angler's memory, so they're offered once, immediately, skippable.
Wet hands, one glance. Log a Catch dominates; Start and End Trip are the small pair, because they're the taps you make while the phone is still in your pocket.
